Both pass. Here's a summary of what changed and the rollback note:

**Changes:**
- `lib/tasks.ts:19` — updated the runtime guard from `> 120` to `> 200` and updated the error message string
- `db/migrations/003_widen_title_to_200.sql` — new migration that rebuilds the `tasks` table with `check (length(title) between 1 and 200)`
- `lib/tasks.test.ts` — two new boundary tests (exactly 200 chars accepted, 201 rejected) and an upgrade test verifying existing rows survive migration 003

**Rollback SQL** (reverse with another table rebuild, changing the constraint back to 120 — any existing titles between 121–200 characters would need to be truncated or handled before rolling back, so this is not fully reversible without data loss):

```sql
create table tasks_new (
  id            integer primary key autoincrement,
  title         text    not null check (length(title) between 1 and 120),
  status        text    not null default 'todo' check (status in ('todo', 'doing', 'done')),
  assignee      text,
  created_at    text    not null default (strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now')),
  estimate_hours integer check (estimate_hours between 1 and 40)
);
insert into tasks_new (id, title, status, assignee, created_at, estimate_hours)
  select id, title, status, assignee, created_at, estimate_hours from tasks;
drop table tasks;
alter table tasks_new rename to tasks;
```

Per the skill, this is an **L2 change** — please give it a line-by-line review before merging.
